headline: Revenue grows, margins compress; EPS guidance lowered
summary_short: Q2 revenue rose 5.3% y/y to $993.5M on growth in Corporate Finance and Technology, but net income fell 19.4% to $57.8M and diluted EPS dropped to $1.99 (from $2.13) as higher direct costs, SG&A and interest expense outpaced the revenue gain.
summary_long: Revenue grew 5.3% y/y to $993.5M, led by Corporate Finance (+8.5%, higher bill rates on transactions/restructuring) and Technology (+18.4%, M&A 'second request' demand); Economic Consulting fell 1.5% (weaker antitrust demand) and Strategic Communications fell 2.6% (lower pass-through revenue). Net income fell 19.4% to $57.8M and diluted EPS to $1.99 (from $2.13) as higher direct costs, SG&A and interest expense outpaced revenue growth, partly offset by a lower tax provision. Adjusted EBITDA was $104.5M (10.5% margin, down from 11.8%). FTI repurchased 2.59M shares for $390.9M in Q2; cash stood at $163.7M. FY2026 revenue guidance held at $3.940B-$4.100B; EPS guidance lowered to $8.70-$9.30; Adjusted EPS guidance initiated at $9.10-$9.70.

Partly offset by Economic Consulting -1.5% (weaker non-M&A antitrust demand) and Strategic Communications -2.6% (a $7.4M pass-through revenue decline).
